h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bongaigaon

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bongaigaon

items.pText: Bongaigaon in lower Assam sits on the main route into the north-east and has a refinery township as well as schools, railway colonies and a growing town centre. FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer based in Vasai, about 1,970 km away, and we send outdoor playground equipment to Bongaigaon by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region sets it up on site.

Assam has one of the longest wet seasons in India, with rain from the pre-monsoon showers in spring through to autumn. Humidity stays high for months. Materials matter here more than almost anywhere. Bare or painted steel rusts quickly, and wooden parts left untreated can rot. Galvanised steel resists corrosion, roto-moulded plastic does not rust or rot, and our play rope carries the same 3-year warranty as the pipes.

richText.heading: Materials for Assam's long wet season

c: Ask any supplier what each part is made of. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded plastic and composite laminates are the safe choices for months of rain. Avoid painted mild steel and untreated timber.

Moss grows on shaded, wet surfaces, so place equipment where it gets some sun and scrub slides with a soft brush during the rains. Build the play area on raised, drained ground with rubber flooring. Install in the drier months between autumn and spring, as grouting needs dry weather. A

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bongaigaon?
